title: The Knight's Sword
start: Talk to Squire Asrol located in the White Knights' Castle's courtyard in Falador.

recommended.t: Activated Falador, Port Sarim, and Varrock lodestones
20 Mining and a steel pickaxe or better

kills.t: Ability to evade level 40 ice warriors and level 47 ice giants

rewards.t: The ability to smith blurite bars and blurite swords

steps.t: Talk to Squire Asrol in the White Knights' Castle courtyard in Falador. [Chat: 1 Chat › 1 And how is life as a squire? › 2 I can make a new sword if you like... › 1 So would these dwarves make another one? › Accept]
p: The start point of the quest

steps.t: Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace library about the Imcando dwarf tribe. [Chat: 3 What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?]

sub.t: If The Giant Dwarf quest is complete, skip this step.
If wielding ring of charos remove that, otherwise option does not appear.

steps.t: Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim (pictured right, north of fairy ring AIQ) with a Redberry pie in the inventory. [Chat: 2 Something else. › 2 Would you like some redberry pie?]

sub.t: If Smithing cape is obtained [Chat: 3 Something else. › 2 Would you like some redberry pie?]

steps.t: Talk to him again. [Chat: 2 Something else.]

sub.t: If Smithing cape is obtained [Chat: 3 Something else.]

steps.t: Climb the ladder to the east, then the first staircase to the west.
Enter Sir Vyvin's room directly south.
Look for a cupboard and open it then search it.

sub.t: If Sir Vyvin keeps noticing, four methods can be used to distract him.
Have a friend talk to Sir Vyvin while you open and search the cupboard.

Open the door to his room and wait for him to walk out. However, this will take a very long time, so keep hopping worlds until you arrive at one where he's already outside, or alternatively just shut the door when he leaves and then search the cupboard.
Wait until he is behind the door, then quickly search the cupboard.
Wait until Sir Vyvin looks at a wall, then quickly search the cupboard.

steps.t: Give Thurgo the portrait. [Chat: 2 Something else.]

sub.t: If Skillcape in Smithing is obtained [Chat: 3 Something else.]

steps.t: Climb down the trapdoor on the hill east of Thurgo's house to enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
Follow the dungeon until blurite rocks are seen (see the map).

sub.t: If you wish to complete Defender of Varrock later, mine an extra blurite ore.
If you wish to complete the medium Falador achievements later, mine another one.

steps.t: Talk to Thurgo with the materials. [Chat: 2 Something else.]

sub.t: If Skillcape in Smithing is obtained [Chat: 3 Something else.]
Bars can be withdrawn at the anvil in Thurgo's hut.

steps.t: Report back to the Squire Asrol. [Chat: 1 Chat]
